channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Bay South Block 15B (UCSF planned)
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Bay South Block 15B (UCSF planned) (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Added · Mission Bay South Block 15B (UCSF planned): Added a sourced dossier for Block 15B.
item.description: Added a sourced dossier for Block 15B. Source: https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Item%202%20-%20UCSF%20Mission%20Bay%20Development%20Overview.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 15B (UCSF planned): Block 15B's notes and milestone said the 2019 land use map designates this block for UCSF institutional use; the map only colors it 'UCSF', and UCSF's June 2025 CAC deck lists Block 15 as Housing, so the use is corrected to residential and the deck is cited for the planned status. The current-parking statement is now labelled our observation in USDA NAIP imagery.
item.description: Block 15B's notes and milestone said the 2019 land use map designates this block for UCSF institutional use; the map only colors it 'UCSF', and UCSF's June 2025 CAC deck lists Block 15 as Housing, so the use is corrected to residential and the deck is cited for the planned status. The current-parking statement is now labelled our observation in USDA NAIP imagery. Source: UCSF Mission Bay Development Overview, Mission Bay CAC, 2025-06-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Item%202%20-%20UCSF%20Mission%20Bay%20Development%20Overview.pdf); OCII Mission Bay Land Use Map, 2019-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Att%201%20Mission%20Bay%20Land%20Use%20Map.pdf); USDA NAIP imagery, viewed 2026-09-29 (https://apps.geo.fpac.usda.gov/geo-imagery/rest/services/naip/conus_naip/ImageServer).

item.title: Planned · Mission Bay South Block 15B (UCSF planned): Same finding as 15A: the Dec 2019 map shows 15B in the 'UCSF' color (no use type; UCSF's own June 2025 CAC deck lists Block 15 as Housing), and the Dec 2015 property map (LRPMP Attachment B, page 12) shows block 15 as a single undivided block without UCSF color (Dec 2019)
item.description: Same finding as 15A: the Dec 2019 map shows 15B in the 'UCSF' color (no use type; UCSF's own June 2025 CAC deck lists Block 15 as Housing), and the Dec 2015 property map (LRPMP Attachment B, page 12) shows block 15 as a single undivided block without UCSF color (Dec 2019). Source: OCII Mission Bay Land Use Map, December 2019; https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/02%20Mission%20Bay.pdf; https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Item%202%20-%20UCSF%20Mission%20Bay%20Development%20Overview.pdf.

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay South Block 15B (UCSF planned): UCSF's September 13, 2016 Note to File analysed temporary contractor parking on Blocks 15 and 16 (recounted in Addendum #4); a separate September 26, 2016 notice covers wet-utility piping and surface work 'in and adjacent to' Blocks 14, 15, 16 and 18 (~2016)
item.description: UCSF's September 13, 2016 Note to File analysed temporary contractor parking on Blocks 15 and 16 (recounted in Addendum #4); a separate September 26, 2016 notice covers wet-utility piping and surface work 'in and adjacent to' Blocks 14, 15, 16 and 18 (~2016). Source: UCSF Campus Planning / UC Regents, 2017-04-28; Regents of the University of California, via CEQAnet, 2016-09-26.

item.title: Planned · Mission Bay South Block 15B (UCSF planned): UC Regents certify the 2014 Long Range Development Plan Environmental Impact Report (November 20, 2014) and approve the plan; the report analysed new housing and a relocated child care facility on Block 15 (as recounted in the 2017 addenda). UCSF's documents name the block 'Block 15' without an A/B split (Nov 2014)
